[lts-active] Revert "Optimize strict module factory chunks (#98421)" (#100866)

Reverts #98421 on `releases/lts/active`.

Fixes #100617

## Summary

#98421 moved `"use strict"` from each module factory into a shared
strict-mode wrapper around the chunk. This exposed an SWC minifier bug
(swc-project/swc#12580): the `if_return` pass could merge a function's
directive prologue into a sequence expression, so the function silently
lost strict mode in production builds.

On canary, this is fixed by bumping to SWC v82.2.0 (#100508). LTS is
still on `swc_core` 79, and getting that fix here would mean also
backporting the v81 (#99720) and v82 (#100270) bumps. So instead, this
reverts the optimization on LTS only. Each factory gets its own `"use
strict"` again, which is the format LTS used before #98421. Canary
doesn't need the revert.

Conflicts with #98953 (Remove TraceRawVcs) were resolved by dropping the
`TraceRawVcs` import. Turbopack snapshot outputs were regenerated with
`UPDATE=1`.

## Verification

- `cargo nextest r -p turbopack-tests --test snapshot` (132 passed,
after `UPDATE=1`)
- `cargo nextest r -p turbopack-ecmascript -p turbopack-browser -p
turbopack-nodejs` (592 passed)
- `cargo check -p turbopack-ecmascript -p turbopack-browser -p
turbopack-nodejs -p next-api` with `-Dwarnings`
- `pnpm check` in `turbopack/crates/turbopack-ecmascript-runtime/js`

<!-- NEXT_JS_LLM -->

[lts-active] Pin Tailwind to 4.3.3 in create-next-app and tests (#101061, #101176) (#101307)

Backports these two fixes to `releases/lts/active`:
- [Pin Tailwind to 4.3.3 in create-next-app
(#101061)](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/101061)
- [Pin Tailwind to 4.3.3 in no-double-tailwind-execution test
(#101176)](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/101176)

Both cherry-pick cleanly (`-x`).

### Why

CI on `releases/lts/active` PRs (e.g. #101280) currently fails for the
same reasons canary did:

- **`no-double-tailwind-execution`** fails with `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`.
`@tailwindcss/node@4.3.4` `require()`s the ESM-only
`magic-string@1.4.5`, which Node.js 20.9.0 can't load.
- **The create-next-app Tailwind tests** (`templates/app.test.ts`,
`matrix-pages-*`) fail with the same error, or with `npm ERR! notarget
No matching version found for @tailwindcss/oxide@4.3.5`.

Pinning `tailwindcss` and its bundler plugin to `4.3.3` fixes both, as
it did on canary.

### Verification

- The diff is identical to the upstream patches (same `git patch-id`).
- Prettier and ESLint are clean on the touched files.
- CI on this PR runs the affected tests.

[lts-active] Turbopack GC fixes (#100279, #100370) (#101308)

Backports these two Turbopack GC fixes to `releases/lts/active`:
- [turbo-tasks-backend: keep recorded GC roots until their TTL expires
(#100279)](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100279)
- [[turbopack] Fix GC/eviction race by dropping task resurrection
(#100370)](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100370)

It builds on #100209 (the #99902 backport) and #100002 (snapshot
consistency fixes), both already on this branch. GC is opt-in on 16.4
(`experimental.turbopackGc`), so this only affects apps that enable it.

## Conflict resolution

**#100279**
- `gc.rs` / `mod.rs` doc comments: took canary's text, which uses plain
backticks instead of intra-doc links.
- `snapshot_and_persist`: the `process` closure keeps this branch's
3-argument signature. #99747, which added a `category` parameter, isn't
on this branch. The PR's `#[cfg(debug_assertions)] gc_protected_roots`
set and the extended `debug_assert!` were added unchanged.

**#100370**
- `aggregation_update.rs` `increase_active_count`: replaced
`resurrect_deleted(...)` with `task.assert_not_deleted(...)`. Kept the
`self.check_optimization_pending(&task)` call that follows it on this
branch; canary removed it in #100146/#100147, which aren't here.
- `aggregation_update.rs` `optimize_queue.pop_front()` arm: kept the
`optimization_pending_flag_already_set` binding. Canary renames it to
`_`, but this branch still reads it in the per-job budget-exhausted path
(`lock_and_mark_optimization_pending`). Canary replaced that path with a
bulk drain.

Everything else applied as-is.

## Verification

- `cargo nextest run -p turbo-tasks-backend`: 289/289 passed. This
includes the new `gc_cross_session` TTL tests and the
`task_by_type_tests` lookup tests.
- `cargo clippy -p turbo-tasks-backend --tests` is clean.
- `cargo check -p turbo-tasks-backend` passes with `--release` and with
`--features task_dirty_cause`.
- `cargo fmt --check` is clean.

CI may show the Tailwind failures currently affecting all
`releases/lts/active` PRs until the Tailwind pin backport (#101307)
lands.

### Core Changes

- [lts-active] Pin Tailwind to 4.3.3 in create-next-app and tests (#101061, #101176) (#101307)
- [lts-active] Automatically compress route handler responses if not already compressed (#101280)
- [lts-active] Turbopack GC fixes for dev (#100279, #100370) (#101308)

### Credits

Huge thanks to @lukesandberg and @eps1lon for helping!
